title: 第3章 弱智巴儿姐
novel_title: 丰腴小村妇，大佬们跪求嫁给他(锦绣钱澄)
content_zh: “还要炖肉补……”张国海被老婆子一步步逼得火气又要冒起来。“行了，就当过节，炖的肉又不是她一个人吃。”范金花摆摆手站起身。“趁现在还不太晚，我去隔壁村屠户家看看还有没有剩肉。”张国海耷拉着头，也站起来，“那，今晚给巴儿姐和阿福换一个屋睡，离那么近，不怪他今天脾气大……”本来就是木板做的隔间，什么动静一清二楚，谁受得了！范金花点了点头，“你去给他们换吧，让他们今晚睡我们的屋。”他们的房间离得远，动静也听得没那么清楚。回头她再交代徐喜弟，今晚小点声。“行了，我去换。也不知道那小子肯不肯……”张国海咕哝着出了火房。范金花先回自己屋，从柜子里翻出两块钱，还没出门，就听见张永福大声嚷嚷。“我不换，我要回自己的屋睡！我不换！”……徐喜弟背着菜筐，来到山脚，挥起镰刀正准备勾菜，就听见不远处的草丛传来动静。是野猪？不对，这年头山里的野猪早被抓吃干净。难道是谁家的牛跑出来了？那可不行，稻田玉米地正绿油油的，牛跑出来地里肯定要遭殃。徐喜弟用镰刀勾了一根拇指粗的树枝，就往草丛走去。先把牛赶回村，再回来割菜吧。“别动，这样舒服……”草丛里清晰传来一个声音。徐喜弟脚步一顿，不是牛，是人！大白天的，躲在山里趴草丛的人，还说这样的话，能是什么好事？她不敢再往前，撞坏别人的好事，容易招惹麻烦。于是她蹑手蹑脚往后倒退。“我尝一口……”这是村里那个跛子，李二拐的声音。李二拐可不是什么好人，村里的大妈见他都要绕道走，何况她这样的大姑娘。徐喜弟干干咽了咽嗓，他和谁在草丛里办事？谁特么这么没眼光，竟能看上那个狗东西？虽然有些好奇，但这事她管不着，还是快走为妙，换个山头割菜吧。正要转身，一个再熟悉不过的声音又从草丛里传出来。“阿巴阿巴……”“巴巴……嗷……”是巴儿姐！村里唯一的一个哑巴，二十六岁了，心智还停留在八九岁。张永福的亲姐姐，徐喜弟的大姑姐！李二拐这个王八羔子，怎么把巴儿姐弄到草丛里去了。换成别人她今天就当不知道，可对方是巴儿姐，她必须管。严格来说，徐喜弟是让巴儿姐一手带大的，但现在不是回忆的时候。她用镰刀把树枝崩尖，然后一脸怒气冲上去。“李二拐，你个狗东西！”她用树尖抵着李二拐的黑屁股，“你他妈起来，信不信我扎穿你的狗叼，让你断子绝孙！”还在低头拱兔子的李二拐，显然事才办到一半。他裤子脱一半，但巴儿姐的裤带还拴得好好的。不过场面也十分不堪。说巴儿姐懂事吧，衣服大敞着躺在草丛里。说不懂事吧，她一只手紧紧抓住自己的裤带子，不让解。看到徐喜弟，巴儿姐也不知是羞还是愤，阿巴阿巴两声，挣扎着把李二拐猛地推开。李二拐身体一个猛退，一屁股按在棍尖上。嗷！他疼得大叫一声，回头恶狠狠地看着徐喜弟。“他妈的，坏我的事，信不信老子把你按地上办了！”李二拐捂着被戳出血窟窿的屁股，就要转身扑徐喜弟。徐喜弟很怕，但这个时候得硬着头皮横，否则落了下风，可能真要被这个狗东西占便宜。她稳稳拿着尖棍，又往李二拐的屁股戳过去。“你来！看我今天不废了你！”她咬牙切齿应道。嗷！李二拐没想到徐喜弟这么敢，被戳痛得又叫了一声。眼看地上的巴儿姐得了松，站起来胡乱地扣衣服，就要过来帮徐喜弟。“徐喜弟，你给我等着！”他只能放下狠话，然后提着裤子，一瘸一拐离开。“阿巴，阿巴……”巴儿姐指着一旁的菜筐，又指了指李二拐，面色潮红。大概意思，就是她一个人来割菜，李二拐跟过来的。徐喜弟心情复杂地看着眼前的巴儿姐。她真的弱智吗？被撞见这种事，还知道脸红。今天要是没撞见，她是不是就要和李二拐把事办了？“他从前有没有对你这样？”徐喜弟一边说着，一边比划刚刚李二拐掐兔子的动作。巴儿姐二十六岁了，智力低下，身材却尤其傲人，该大的大，该小的小。那两只八斤重的大肥兔，经常跟着她蹦蹦跳跳的走姿一通乱甩，范金花也没给做厚一点的小衣。而且巴儿姐力气也不小，李二拐那样的，她能轻松按在地上摩擦。“阿巴阿巴……巴巴……”巴儿姐胡乱说了一通。徐喜弟也听不懂，看她脸越来越红，心里大概有了猜测。李二拐肯定用了什么东西，哄骗的巴儿姐。糖？她想也不想，就把手伸进巴儿姐的衣兜。果然从里面摸出来一片猪油糖的纸皮。“阿巴，阿巴……”巴儿姐被摸出来糖皮，有些恼怒，忽然就气呼呼拿起一边的空菜筐，背着回家去了。徐喜弟嘴角直抽抽，对，巴儿姐从小就这样。脾气说来就来，活想干就干，不想干就到处溜达晃荡。连张国海和范金花，也管不了她。打没少挨打，但就是不长记性，今天打完，明天还照旧。徐喜弟不到一岁大就抱来张家，跟巴儿姐睡的。巴儿姐每天背着她，家里的活东干一点西干一点，更多的都是背着满村溜达。张家没给她上学，她五岁就知道怂恿巴儿姐，背着她走好几里地去学校，坐在墙根听课。巴儿姐就在操场玩石仔等她。反正范金花也不管，只要人没丢就行。直到她八岁，能帮着家里煮饭，就再也没什么机会去学校听课了。十二岁，开始搬到了张永福的屋，伺候他吃喝拉撒。哎……往事不能回首，太苦了。徐喜弟叹了一口气，看着巴儿姐远去的背影，无奈地摇摇头。又看看走得更远的李二拐，心里还是有些担心，李二拐会不会蹲在前边等巴儿姐？这么想，她还是背着筐跟上去。
content_en: "I still need to stew meat to make up for it..." Zhang Guohai was forced step by step by the old woman to the point where he was getting angry again."Okay, let's just treat it as a festival. She won't be the only one to eat the stew." Fan Jinhua waved her hands and stood up."Before it's not too late, I'll go to the butcher's house in the next village to see if there is any leftover meat." Zhang Guohai hung his head and stood up, "Then, let Sister Ba'er and Ah Fu sleep in a room tonight. They are so close. Don't blame him for being grumpy today..." It was originally a partition made of wooden boards. Every movement was clear, who could bear it!Fan Jinhua nodded, "Go and change for them, let them sleep in our room tonight." Their rooms were far away, and the movement could not be heard so clearly.Later, she told Xu Xidi to keep her voice down tonight."Okay, I'll change it. I don't know if that guy is willing to..." Zhang Guohai muttered and walked out of the fire room.Fan Jinhua went back to her room first and took out two dollars from the cabinet. Before she went out, she heard Zhang Yongfu yelling loudly."I won't change, I want to go back to my own room to sleep! I won't change!"... Xu Xidi carried the vegetable basket on his back and came to the foot of the mountain. He waved his sickle and was about to hook the vegetables when he heard movement from the grass not far away.Is it a wild boar?No, all the wild boars in the mountains have been caught and eaten these days.Could it be that someone's cow escaped?That won't work. The rice fields and corn fields are lush and green, and the cows will definitely suffer if they run out of the fields.Xu Xidi hooked a branch as thick as his thumb with his sickle and walked towards the grass.Let’s drive the cattle back to the village first, and then come back to cut vegetables."Don't move, it feels so comfortable..." A voice came clearly from the grass.Xu Xidi paused in his steps, he was not a cow, he was a human!What kind of good thing could a person hiding in the mountains and lying in the grass say such things in broad daylight?She didn't dare to go any further, ruining other people's good deeds and easily causing trouble.So she tiptoed backwards."Let me have a taste..." This was the voice of the cripple in the village, Li Erguai.Li Erguai was not a good person. Every aunt in the village would avoid him when they saw him, let alone a big girl like her.Xu Xidi swallowed dryly. Who was he doing business with in the grass?Who is so blind as to fall in love with that piece of shit?Although she was a little curious, she couldn't control this matter, so it was better to leave quickly and switch to cutting vegetables on the mountain.Just as he was about to turn around, a very familiar voice came from the grass again."Aba, Aba..." "Baba...ouch..." It's Sister Ba'er!The only mute in the village is twenty-six years old, but his mind is still at the age of eight or nine.Zhang Yongfu’s biological sister and Xu Xidi’s eldest aunt!Why did Li Erguai, that bastard, get Sister Ba'er into the grass?If it were anyone else, she would have pretended not to know about it today, but the other person was Sister Baer, ​​and she had to take care of it.Strictly speaking, Xu Xidi was brought up by Sister Ba'er, but now is not the time to recall.She used her scythe to cut off the branches, then rushed forward with an angry look on her face."Li Erguai, you piece of shit!" She pressed the tip of the tree against Li Erguai's black ass. "Get the fuck up. Believe it or not, I will pierce your dog's mouth and make you extinct!" Li Erguai, who was still bowing his head to hump the rabbit, was obviously only halfway done.He had half of his pants off, but Sister Baer's belt was still tightly tied.But the scene was also very unbearable.Call Sister Ba'er sensible, lying in the grass with her clothes wide open.Call it ignorant, she tightly grasped the belt of her pants with one hand and refused to let it go.Seeing Xu Xidi, Sister Ba'er didn't know whether she was ashamed or angry. She screamed "Aba, Aba, Aba" and struggled to push Li Erguai away.Li Erguai jerked back and pressed his butt on the tip of the stick.Ouch!He screamed in pain and turned around to look at Xu Xidi fiercely."Damn it, you ruined my business. Believe it or not, I will push you to the ground!" Li Erguai covered his butt with a bloody hole and was about to turn around and attack Xu Xidi.Xu Xidi was very scared, but he had to bite the bullet at this time, otherwise he would be at a disadvantage and might really be taken advantage of by this bitch.She held the pointed stick steadily and poked Li Erguai's butt."Come here! See if I don't destroy you today!" She gritted her teeth and replied.Ouch!Li Erguai didn't expect Xu Xidi to be so brave, and he screamed again in pain when he was poked.Seeing that Sister Ba'er on the ground was relieved, she stood up and buttoned her clothes randomly, and was about to come over to help Xu Xidi."Xu Xidi, just wait for me!" He could only put down his harsh words, then lifted up his pants and limped away."Aba, Aba..." Sister Ba'er pointed to the vegetable basket on the side and then to Li Erguai, her face flushed.The general meaning is that she came to cut vegetables alone, and Li Erguai followed her.Xu Xidi looked at Sister Ba'er in front of him with complicated emotions.Is she really mentally retarded?I still blush when I see something like this happen.If she hadn't bumped into her today, would she have done something with Li Erguai?"Has he ever done this to you before?" Xu Xidi said as he gestured to Li Erguai's pinching of the rabbit just now.Sister Ba'er is twenty-six years old, with low intelligence, but a particularly proud figure. She should be big when she should be, and small when she should be.Those two eight-pound big fat rabbits often swung around as she jumped around, and Fan Jinhua didn't even make them thicker clothes.Moreover, Sister Ba'er is also very strong. Like Li Erguai, she can easily press her to the ground and rub her."Aba Aba...Baba..." Sister Ba'er said randomly.Xu Xidi didn't understand either. Seeing her face getting redder and redder, he probably had a guess in his mind.Li Erguai must have used something to coax Sister Ba'er.sugar?Without thinking, she put her hand into Sister Ba'er's pocket.Sure enough, a piece of lard candy paper was taken out from inside."Aba, Aba..." Sister Ba'er was a little annoyed when the candy skin was found. Suddenly she angrily picked up the empty vegetable basket on the side and carried it home.The corners of Xu Xidi's mouth twitched, yes, Sister Ba'er has been like this since she was a child.His temper comes when he wants, he can do whatever he wants to do, and he can wander around when he doesn't want to do it.Even Zhang Guohai and Fan Jinhua couldn't control her.I was beaten a lot, but I just didn't remember it. After today, it will be the same tomorrow.Brother Xu Xi was brought to the Zhang family when he was less than one year old and slept with Sister Ba'er.Sister Ba'er carries her on her back every day, doing a little bit of work around the house, and mostly walking around the village.The Zhang family didn't send her to school. When she was five years old, she encouraged Sister Ba'er to carry her several miles to school and sit on the wall to listen to classes.Sister Ba'er was waiting for her in the playground playing with stones.Fan Jinhua doesn't care anyway, as long as no one is lost.Until she was eight years old and could help the family cook, she no longer had the opportunity to attend school.At the age of twelve, he moved to Zhang Yongfu's house and served him food, drink, and toilet.Sigh... I can't look back on the past, it's too painful.Xu Xidi sighed, looked at Sister Ba'er's retreating back, and shook his head helplessly.Looking at Li Erguai who was walking further, I was still a little worried. Would Li Erguai be squatting in front waiting for Sister Ba'er?Thinking this way, she still followed with the basket on her back.
